record.exceptions: Detailed goods and directional exemptions unknown; rail traffic is not treated as stopped.
record.enforcement: Carrier-reported road suspension, not an all-port closure observation.
record.consequences: No general economic effect is quantified by this research packet.
record.relationship: No exact current parent/phase match; distinct from Khorgos visitor-centre, Manzhouli and Erenhot/Suifenhe rail regimes. Related carrier references to other gates are not new additions.
record.status_observation: Historical dated evidence only; an unknown endpoint is not evidence of present open or closed status.
record.current_timing: dated evidence; numeric duration withheld; see qualification
record.current_corrections: The20August carrier advisory explicitly separates road suspension from rail congestion. Exact road onset, issuing authority, cargo exemptions and actual road return remain unknown. Generic15August port-stop/copper-resumption wording is not adopted for trucks; NIA observes trains moving on16–17August. Later battery-only and rail-described planned-return entries do not extend the whole-road cohort. No numerical duration.
